What Acne Program Do I Need?

Starter Program
Perfect for random breakouts here and there OR if you’re just starting to breakout.


Intermediate Program
For those who’ve been struggling with breakouts for 6–12 months, where your skin keeps getting the same breakouts over and over and never seems to get better no matter what you try.


Advanced Program
Best for those who’ve been struggling with stubborn acne for 12+ months, where breakouts are constant and more severe. You’ve tried it all - spent $1000s on products, medications and treatments but nothing has ever worked.

Ingredients

(100% All-Natural. No Nasties)


REPAIR

Each capsule contains active ingredients: Burdock Root Extract equiv. to 1g dry root, Dandelion Root Extract equiv. to 2g dry root, Milk Thistle Extract equiv. to 1.54g dry fruit (standardised to Silymarin 17.6mg), Vitex Extract equiv. to 500mg dry fruit, Ashwagandha Root Extract equiv. to 1.5g dry root, Vitamin C 22.5mg, Vitamin D3 12.5 micrograms, Zinc 15mg, Vitamin B3 4mg, Vitamin B2 600 micrograms.

RESTORE

Each capsule contains these 3 clinically studied strains:

  • Bacillus coagulans (UNIQUE IS-2) 1 billion CFU,

  • Lactobacillus rhamnosus (GG 1) billion CFU

  • Bifidobacterium animalis ssp. lactis (BL-04) 1 billion CFU.

How to use

4 capsules a day. Thats it!


☀️ Morning: 1 REPAIR + 1 RESTORE

🌚 Night: 1 REPAIR + 1 RESTORE

We then recommend Skin & Gut Maintain to prevent any future blemishes. You can save 50% off with any Skin & Gut Program purchase!

Label Warnings

WARNINGS: Always read the label and health warnings. Follow the directions for use. Minerals can only be of assistance if dietary intake is inadequate


Contains zinc which may be dangerous if taken in large amounts or for a long period. Vitex agnus-castus may affect hormones and medicines such as oral contraceptives.

Consult your health professional before use.


Not suitable for children. Bacillus coagulans may affect the way some medicines work, including immunosuppressants.

Consult your health professional before taking with other medicines.

Quality Assurance®

Manufactured in Qld Australia at a facility certified by both the TGA and GMP standards.


Extensively examined & tested for heavy metals, contaminants, and microbiological content by independent, TGA-registered, ISO/IEC-certified laboratories.


All PuraU™ products undergo biannual re-testing in a TGA-approved laboratory to verify active ingredient levels on the label remain consistent throughout the product's shelf life, a process known as stability testing.

REAL TRANSFORMATION Stories

Slide 1 of 6

Acne doesn’t start on the skin. It starts in the gut.

What you see on the surface is the final symptom of a chain reaction happening underneath.

Slide 1 of 5

Stage 1: Damaged Gut Lining

Stress, antibiotics, alcohol, processed foods, medications or the contraceptive pill weakens the gut lining and disrupts healthy gut microbiome. This causes tiny gaps to form in the gut barrier.

This is where acne begins its life

Stage 2: Inflammation Takes Over

When things leak through the weakened gut lining, your immune system jumps into action to protect you. This causes more inflammation inside the body, and the skin becomes easily irritated and heals slower.

This sets the stage for breakouts to start forming

Stage 3: Hormones Become Disrupted

When inflammation keeps rising inside the body, it throws off your hormones, especially the hormones that control oil production. This causes excess sebum, oily skin & hormonal flare-ups or menstrual breakouts (for the girls).

This is why your skin suddenly feels oilier, more reactive or you suddenly “breakout”.

Stage 4: Pores Get Clogged

With more oil + inflammation + slower healing, the skin barrier becomes weaker. This makes it much easier for pores to get clogged, dead-skin to build up & more bacteria on the skin.

At this point, your skin is really struggling to heal itself and keep everything balanced.

Stage 5: It Reaches The Surface

At this point the flood gates open & breakouts finally reach the surface. This is the part people see but it's not where it started.

That’s why topicals, medications, treatments etc don't work because acne is a gut issue. To get real, permanent results, you need to heal the gut first.

Our 2-Step Acne Program

Acne doesn’t start on the surface, so neither does our solution. The Skin & Gut Program™ repairs & restores your gut in 30-90 days, so that your skin can finally clear, permanently.

FREQUENTLY ASKED Questions

What Acne Program do I need?

Starter Program
Perfect for random breakouts here and there OR if you’re just starting to breakout.


Intermediate Program
For those who’ve been struggling with breakouts for 6–12 months, where your skin keeps getting the same breakouts over and over and never seems to get better no matter what you try.


Advanced Program
Best for those who’ve been struggling with stubborn acne for 12+ months, where breakouts are constant and more severe. You’ve tried it all - spent $1000s on products, medications and treatments but nothing has ever worked.

Can I take these when breastfeeding or pregnant?

Unfortunately, the Inside & Out Gut Program is not recommended for those pregnant or breastfeeding. Please consult your health care practitioner if you are breastfeeding/pregnant or need further clarification.

I still don't know which option is right for me?

We recommend taking our QUIZ which will recommend the right program for you OR feel free to email us (support@purau.com.au). We're more than happy to help!

When Will I See Results?

For long-term, stubborn breakouts healing takes time but most people see results between days 15-30, with less inflammation after 4 weeks and a significant reduction in breakouts by weeks 6-8. By week 12, skin appears clearer, calmer glowing!

Do I take it with food?

Yes! We recommend taking it with food for best results. However, if you struggle to swallow capsules you can always twist open the capsules and sprinkle it onto your food.
